data.body:
Follow-up on the dual-signal outage advisory: deliberately not actioned. The earlier release-change proposal was removed from the amended commit because the existing release path already recovers when telemetry returns: once a real spend signal is available again, `signal_unavailable` becomes false, spend is evaluated from real data, and the deny policy detaches normally when the circuit-breaker condition has cleared. Keeping the deny attached only for the duration of the telemetry outage is intentional fail-closed behavior for this circuit breaker; releasing solely because the outage crossed a UTC boundary would weaken that safeguard.

Kept the three blocking coverage additions for `_refresh_rates`, `_normalise`, and `_metered_spend`. Did not close the ticket and did not push.
